card.name: Clinical trial results text in labels
card.fires_on: Scattered words inside adverse-reaction and clinical-trial passages of drug labels, such as numbers in incidence rates, table references, and partway through words like immunogenicity or asenapine.

modes.label: Numbers and table references
modes.description: A digit or space in incidence figures or before a table number.

modes.label: Partway through trial or drug words
modes.description: Middle of a medical word or a short word in a trial-population phrase.

card.writes: It mostly suppresses commerce and advertising words, so it keeps text in a clinical register; the promoted tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It fires in the dry results and safety sections of drug labels, and it pushes the model away from marketing language.
